skills.name: scrape-for-context
skills.description: Turn one URL into clean markdown for a model to read. Use when a user gives you a link, when you need a page as grounding, or when a previous fetch returned a JavaScript shell or a cookie wall.

skills.name: research-a-company
skills.description: Build a company profile from its domain: identity, logos and colours, positioning, and site structure. Use for enrichment, competitor research, or answering what a company does.

skills.name: extract-structured-data
skills.description: Pull typed, schema-shaped JSON out of web pages. Use when you need fields rather than prose, or the same fields from many pages.

skills.name: build-a-dataset
skills.description: Assemble many pages into a table using queued crawl and batch jobs rather than a loop. Use for corpora, bulk enrichment, or any job over more than a handful of URLs.
